assessments.finding: The filter validates each decoded old-cache Issue before tracker_diff_notifications. Malformed JSON becomes an empty old set; invalid individual identities are omitted. A provider failure returns before this block and leaves the old cache intact, so stale invalid rows do not create notifications through this path.
assessments.evidence: The selected panel hydration test proves invalid cached identities are omitted from panel state without rewriting the cache; the selected diff test proves status/blocker event semantics. Neither drives spawn_issue_cache_refresh with an invalid old-cache row.
assessments.residual: The filter validates the Issue identity but does not additionally compare Issue.provider with the DB provider-key column. That storage-key binding is outside this change and no current acceptance receipt claims it; it is a possible future cache-integrity hardening seam, not evidence of unsafe host behavior here.
assessments.qualification: Refresh-worker malformed-old-cache branch remains unexecuted; document this instead of claiming exhaustive host cache coverage.
